scope: Existing IT, room heat load and base cooling input are frozen. No rescaling to 20 MW.
The storage abstraction is compatible with a chilled-water energy reservoir / stratified-tank operating model, not a parameter refit of the old fully mixed temperature tank.

Tank volume, geometry, UA, water mass flow and outlet temperature are not input variables. Rated usable cooling is assumed deliverable within a suitable chilled-water operating window; outlet-temperature adequacy is not newly validated.

All checks concern 5-minute average energy operation. Frozen 10-second baseline headroom is additionally checked under 5-minute held TES commands, but not as a validation of fast control or new thermal dynamics.
Operating cost, DSO-DOE coordination, ESS dispatch, DFL and HIL are not implemented here.
Legacy temperature model and its reports remain unchanged as an auxiliary candidate, not erased or claimed validated by this reduction.
